promise_band.headline: We Turn Up On The Day We Said
promise_band.body: Read our reviews and you will notice people rarely lead with the mowing. They lead with the fact that we came when we said we would. That is the part most lawn services get wrong, and it is the part we build the whole schedule around. You get a day, you get a heads-up if the weather moves it, and you get a crew that finishes the property before it leaves.

signature_system.headline: One Crew For The Whole Property
signature_system.intro: Most customers start with mowing and end up handing us the rest — the beds, the mulch, the fall leaves, the driveway in January. It is the same crew and the same schedule either way, so nothing falls between two contractors.

blocks.title: Priced from a walk of your property
blocks.body: We do not quote lawns off a satellite photo. We come out, look at the slope, the trees, the bed edges and the gate widths, and price the actual property. The number you get is the number you pay.

blocks.title: Commercial equipment, maintained
blocks.body: Walk-behind and stand-on mowers kept sharp, so the grass is cut rather than torn and the stripe is even. Sharp blades are the difference between a lawn that recovers by Thursday and one that browns at the tips.

signature_system.steps_title: The property gets left tidy, every visit

steps.title: Edges and trim lines cut
steps.body: Beds, walkways and fence lines, not just the open lawn.

steps.title: Clippings and debris cleared
steps.body: Blown off the walks and driveway before we load up.

steps.title: Gates shut, lines respected
steps.body: We stay on your property and leave it closed up behind us.

guarantee.title: If it's not right, we come back
guarantee.body: Tell us within a couple of days of the visit and we return and fix it. We would rather make a second trip than have you looking at something that bothers you every time you pull in the driveway.

steps.label: Step One
steps.title: Free on-site estimate
steps.body: Tell us the address and what you want handled. We walk the property and put a price in writing.

steps.label: Step Two
steps.title: Pick your schedule
steps.body: Weekly or bi-weekly mowing, a one-off clean-up, or a full-season plan that carries into snow season.

steps.label: Step Three
steps.title: We show up and finish
steps.body: Cut, trimmed, edged and blown off. You get the same crew on the same day each visit.

about_block.headline: A Local Crew, Not A Franchise
about_block.body: Smile Lawn Care is Eric's company, and Eric is usually the one who comes out to do your estimate. We work Wilkes-Barre and the boroughs around it — close enough that we are not driving an hour to reach you, and close enough that our reputation here is the only marketing that has ever mattered. Thirty-seven Google reviews, every one of them five stars.
checklist: Licensed and insured, residential and commercial
Free on-site estimates with the price in writing
Year-round: spring clean-up through winter plowing

seo_body.headline: Lawn Care In Wilkes-Barre, PA
paragraphs: Lawns in the Wyoming Valley have a short, hard season. Growth comes on fast and wet in May, stalls out in the July heat, and then the mature maples and oaks that make these neighbourhoods pleasant drop a leaf load heavy enough to smother turf if it sits through November.

That is why we schedule the whole year rather than just the mowing months: bed clean-up and mulch in spring, a mowing and trim cycle that holds height through the summer stress, leaf clearing in the fall, and plowing and salt once the driveway freezes over.
We cover Wilkes-Barre, Plains, Pittston, Edwardsville, Exeter, Swoyersville, Wyoming, Forty Fort, Kingston, Laflin, Moosic, Luzerne, Pringle, Larksville, Laurel Run, Hudson, Hilldale and Shavertown.
checklist: Weekly and bi-weekly mowing, trimming and edging
Fertilizer, weed control and pressure washing
Snow plowing, snow blowing and ice control

faqs.q: How much does lawn mowing cost?
faqs.a: It depends on the size of the lot, how much trimming and edging it needs, and how steep it is. That is why the estimate is free and done on site — we look at the actual property and give you a written price rather than a range you cannot plan around.

faqs.q: Do you mow weekly or every other week?
faqs.a: Both. Weekly is the right call for most lawns from May through June when growth is fastest, and plenty of properties move to bi-weekly through the summer. We will tell you honestly which one your lawn needs.

If you are just outside that list, call and ask — we will tell you straight whether we can service you properly.

faqs.q: Do you handle snow in the winter?
faqs.a: Yes. Snow plowing, snow blowing and ice control, for the same properties we mow in the summer. Booking your snow service before the first storm is worth doing — routes fill up once it is already snowing.
Yes, both. We are happy to provide proof of insurance before any work starts, which matters if you are a landlord, a property manager or a commercial site.

faqs.q: Do I need to be home when you come?
faqs.a: No. Most of our customers are at work when we service the property. We just need access — an unlocked gate or a code — and we shut everything behind us when we leave.

faqs.q: What if I am not happy with the visit?
faqs.a: Tell us within a couple of days and we come back and put it right. We would rather make a second trip than leave you looking at something that bothers you.
